rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Tilde provides a local-first system for managing AI agent profiles and context. Users configure their professional identity, technical preferences, skills, and knowledge once in a local profile stored at ~/.tilde/profile.yaml, then multiple MCP-compatible AI agents can access this unified context. Features human-in-the-loop approval for agent-proposed updates, document ingestion from PDFs and resumes, team context sharing, and multiple storage backends including YAML, SQLite, and Mem0.
